question: Member of Rajya Sabha, Sonal Mansingh is an eminent dancer of _________ and Bharatanatyam.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odissi Dance

 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its fluid movements, intricate gestures, and strong footwork.
 
• The dance is characterized by its sculpturesque poses and the tribhangi posture, which involves the independent movement of the head, chest, and pelvis.
 
• Odissi dance is traditionally performed to Odia music and is deeply rooted in the region's culture and religious traditions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Mohiniyattam​**

 
 
• Mohiniyattam, is an Indian classical dance form that developed and remained popular in the state of Kerala.
 
• The origin and popularity of this dance form is closely tagged to the great Tamil dance master Vadivelu, one of the Thanjavur quartets. 
 
• One among the eight Indian classical dance forms, Mohiniyattam is a graceful dance to watch and is a solo recital by women. 
 
• The term Mohiniyattam comes from the words mohini meaning a woman who enchants onlookers and aattam meaning graceful and sensuous body movements. Thus, the word Mohiniyattam literally means - dance of the enchantress.
 
 

 
• Kathakali ​

 
 
• Kathakali is another classical dance form of Kerala. 
 
• The term Kathakali is derived from katha which means "story or a conversation, or a traditional tale", and kaḷi which means "performance" or "play". 
 
• The dance symbolises the eternal fight between good and evil.
 
 
 
• Kathak
 
 
• They were originally a cast of storytellers in north India (Utter Pradesh) who used to sing gestures and songs in temples.
 
• This word is derived from Katha (Sanskrit Word).
 
• This dance was spread in India during the Bhakti Movement in the 16th-17th centuries.
 
 
 
• Famous Kathak dancers – Birju Maharaj, Lachu Maharaj, Sambu Maharaj, Shovna Narayan, Sitara Devi.
